import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))

    cur = a[0]
    best = a[0]

    for i in range(1, n):
        cur = max(a[i], cur + a[i])
        if cur > best:
            best = cur

    sys.stdout.write(str(best) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
